Taqat majboot iraade se aati hai.
Padho, padho, padho.
Bade dimaag vicharon par, chhote log logon par baat karte hain.
"Apne aap ko limit mat karo; expectations limit."
Ghadi mat dekho; ghadi jaise karo. Bas chalte raho.
"Tum jo karte usse matter banta—tum decide karo kaunsa."
Failure se failure tak ka safar, bina josh khoe.
Ready ho ya na ho—success aata hai.
"Soch bovo, action kaat lo."
Tumhare saath kya hota hai itna nahi—matter karta.
"Tumhari limitation bas imagination hai."
